newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ weather forecasts for Christmas Day, Boxing Day.
newsitem.headline: NZ weather forecasts for Christmas Day, Boxing Day.

text.p: Outlook for Christmas, issued 8.00 a.m. Friday, December 20, by Blue Skies Weather & Climate Services Ltd, Christchurch:
North Island: Fine sunny weather is likely in all areas on Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Lights winds and mild to warm temperatures.
South Island: Fine and sunny across most of the island on Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Mild with northerly or northeasterly winds. Some cloud at times on the West Coast.
